description: Turns typed text into morse code, played out as gates once a trigger starts it

params.text: Sets the rate of the code, fully clockwise giving a dot a third of the length it has fully counter-clockwise

inputs.text: A rising edge here starts the message from its first character; the message plays once and then stops until the next edge

outputs.text: 10V for the length of each dot and dash, 0V through the gaps between them

notes: the message is typed into the text field, and any character without a morse equivalent is skipped
a new module holds the word mscHack in its text field; type over it to send something else
the module produces nothing until a rising edge reaches its trigger input, and it plays the message once per edge

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
